proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for healthchecks, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the healthchecks service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the healthchecks
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  healthchecks:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.healthchecks.loadbalancer.server.port=8000
      - traefik.http.routers.healthchecks.rule=Host(`healthchecks.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.healthchecks.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.healthchecks.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.healthchecks.service=healthchecks
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.healthchecks.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.healthchecks.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Healthchecks: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-healthchecks/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: healthchecks-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: healthchecks
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
  SECRET_KEY: ''
  SITE_ROOT: ''
  SITE_NAME: ''
  SUPERUSER_EMAIL: ''
  SUPERUSER_PASSWORD: ''
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: healthchecks-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: healthchecks
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: healthchecks
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: healthchecks
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: healthchecks
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: healthchecks
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: healthchecks
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/healthchecks:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: healthchecks-env
        ports:
        - name: port-8000
          containerPort: 8000
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: healthchecks-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: healthchecks-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: healthchecks-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: healthchecks
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: healthchecks
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: healthchecks
  ports:
  - name: port-8000
    port: 8000
    targetPort: 8000
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# healthchecks.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-healthchecks/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Healthchecks (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/healthchecks:latest
ContainerName=healthchecks
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Environment=SECRET_KEY=
Environment=SITE_ROOT=
Environment=SITE_NAME=
Environment=SUPERUSER_EMAIL=
Environment=SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=
# Environment=ALLOWED_HOSTS=

# Environment=CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=
# Environment=DEBUG=True
# Environment=DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL=
# Environment=EMAIL_HOST=

# Environment=EMAIL_HOST_USER=
# Environment=EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD=
# Environment=EMAIL_USE_TLS=
# Environment=INTEGRATIONS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS=
# Environment=PING_EMAIL_DOMAIN=

Volume=/path/to/healthchecks/config:/config:Z
PublishPort=8000:8000

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
